column1: 21688§dusk§dʌsk§You can catch a glimpse of some more of the rainforest's wildlife as it comes out at dusk to feed.§**黄昏**时分，当雨林中的野生动物出来觅食时，你能看见更多的野生动物。§
21689§cease§siːs§The music ceased, and the audience broke into applause.§音乐**停**了，观众爆发出热烈的掌声。§
21690§arable§ˈærəbl§On the top of the hill, the arable ground has been seeded.§山顶上那片**可耕种**的土地已经播种了。§
21691§congested§kənˈdʒestɪd§Can the world avoid being locked into congested and polluting means of transport?§世界能否避免受**拥挤**而污染的交通方式的困扰？§
21692§split§splɪt§The party split up into several groups.§这个党派**分裂**成几个集团。§
21693§linger§ˈlɪŋgə(r)§The children lingered at the zoo until closing time.§动物园关门时孩子们才**恋恋不舍**地离去。§
21694§distinct§dɪˈstɪŋkt§Why do humans, alone among all animal species, display a distinct left- or right-handedness?§为什么唯独人类和其他动物不一样，会出现**独特**的惯用左手或右手现象呢？§
21695§negotiate§nɪˈgəʊʃieɪt§By no means does everyone in the world know English well enough to negotiate in it.§要让世界上每个人的英语都好得可以用它来进行**谈判**是不可能的。§
21696§cruel§ˈkruːəl§The anthropologist concluded that the tribesmen were unusually aggressive and cruel.§人类学家得出结论，这个部落的人侵略成性，无比**凶残**。§
21697§womb§wuːm§Foetuses can be tested while in the womb.§胎儿在**子宫**里的时候可以进行检查。§
21698§advantageous§ˌædvənˈteɪdʒəs§A free trade agreement would be advantageous to both countries.§自由贸易协议对两国都**有益处**。§
21699§manoeuvre§məˈnuːvə(r)§We will be asked to perform some standard manoeuvres during the driving test.§驾照考试会要求我们做一些标准的**操作**。§
21700§predatory§ˈpredətri§The eagle is a kind of cruel predatory bird which kills its prey with its claws.§鹰是一种残忍的**食肉**鸟类，它用锋利的爪子捕杀猎物。§
21701§converse§kənˈvɜːs§The converse was also found to be true.§**反之**同样成立。§
21702§context§ˈkɒntekst§You can guess the meaning of the word from the context.§你可以根据**上下文**猜出这个词的意思。§

21703§entrepreneurial§ˌɒntrəprəˈnɜːriəl§The provision of small loans to support the entrepreneurial dreams and ambitions of youth can be an effective means to help them change their lives.§小额贷款为年轻人的**创业**梦想与雄心提供支持，可以成为帮助他们改变人生的有效方式。§
21704§dearth§dɜːθ§There is a dearth of good young players at the moment.§目前优秀的年轻选手**太少**了。§
21705§adventurous§ədˈventʃərəs§The street may be attractive to children as a place to find adventurous play.§这条街应该对孩子们非常具有吸引力，他们可以在这里找到**惊险刺激**的游戏。§
21706§exploitative§ɪkˈsplɔɪtətɪv§It is also a place where some children are exposed, with little or no protection, to exploitative employment.§在这里有的孩子只能得到些许保护或根本没有保护，被雇主**无情压榨**。§
21707§impoverish§ɪmˈpɒvərɪʃ§Excessive farming had impoverished the soil here.§过度耕种使得这里的土地变得**贫瘠**了。§

21708§convection§kənˈvekʃn§The flow, thought to be in the form of convection currents, is powerful enough to fracture the “eggshell” of the crust into plates.§这股水流，人们认为其呈**对流**的形式，其能量足以将地壳表面如“蛋壳”的坚硬物质冲破成板块。§
21709§plateau§ˈplætəʊ§In the Deccan Plateau in Western India, there are more than two million cubic kilometers of lava.§在印度西部的德干**高原**，有超过200万立方公里的熔岩。§
21710§crust§krʌst§Tectonic plates are the plates which make up the earth's crust and mantle.§构造板块是指构成地球**地壳**及地幔的板块。§
21711§overlie§ˌəʊvəˈlaɪ§It is recognized by the public that overlying the beach is very comfortable.§大家公认**躺在**海滩上很舒服。§改例句：overlie 是及物动词，删去 on
21712§brittle§ˈbrɪtl§The heritage antiques are brittle with age.§这些古董年代久远，极其**易碎**。§
21713§collision§kəˈlɪʒn§These fracture zones, where the collisions occur, are where earthquakes happen.§这些断裂带是**碰撞**发生的地方，也是地震发生区。§

21714§extrusion§ɪkˈstruːʒn§Vast bubbles of magma—molten rock from the mantle—inch towards the surface, cooling slowly, to show through as granite extrusion.§岩浆，也就是熔岩，鼓着巨大的泡泡从地幔中涌向表面，慢慢冷却，看上去就像经过**挤压**后的花岗岩。§改例句：插入语 molten rock from the mantle 缺后一个破折号
21715§pumice§ˈpʌmɪs§Is the pumice light and full of the holes?§**浮岩**是既轻又密布坑洞的吗？§
21716§predictable§prɪˈdɪktəbl§But volcanoes are not very predictable.§但是火山爆发很难**预测**。§

21717§geological§ˌdʒiːəˈlɒdʒɪkl§A geological survey shows that there will be an earthquake in the south part of the country.§**地质学**调查显示该国南部地区将有一次地震发生。§改例句：There is a geological survey that… 不通，改 A geological survey shows that…

21718§halve§hɑːv§A development of 194 houses would take up 14 hectares of land above ground and occupy 2.7 hectares below it, while the number of roads would be halved.§建造194栋房子要占用14公顷的地上面积和2.7公顷的地下面积，而道路的数量则会**减半**。§
21719§assimilate§əˈsɪməleɪt§We assimilate some kinds of food more easily than others.§和其他食物相比，有些食物更容易被**吸收**。§
21720§harbour§ˈhɑːbə(r)§A port must be distinguished from a harbour.§港口和**港湾**在概念上必须区分开来。§
21721§hybrid§ˈhaɪbrɪd§They suggest small low-emission cars for urban use and larger hybrid or lean-burn cars for use elsewhere.§他们建议在城市中使用低排量的小型车，而将那些较大的**混合动力**汽车和稀燃车应用在其他地方。§
21722§inhale§ɪnˈheɪl§Sometimes people have to inhale secondhand smoke.§有时候，人们不得不**吸入**二手烟。§
21723§decibel§ˈdesɪbel§The normal noise threshold for private housing is 55 decibels.§正常情况下私人住宅区的噪音临界点是55**分贝**。§
21724§voyage§ˈvɔɪɪdʒ§They made a voyage across the Atlantic.§他们做了一次横越大西洋的**航行**。§
21725§contingency§kənˈtɪndʒənsi§The extra people can cover contingencies, such as when crises take people away from the workplace.§编外人员可以弥补**紧急事件**（所造成的职位空缺），如当危急事件使得人们离开工作岗位时。§
21726§relieve§rɪˈliːv§These tablets are used to help relieve hay fever and symptoms due to allergies.§这些药片用于**缓解**花粉热及其他因过敏引发的症状。§
21727§stance§stæns§Can you feel how much more comfortable a relaxed stance is?§以这样一种放松的**姿势**，你能感觉舒适多了吗？§
21728§conduct§ˈkɒndʌkt§Some experiments are conducted by this professor and others are not.§有些实验是这位教授**指导**的，有些不是。§
21729§mate§meɪt§Many seabirds return to the same island every year to mate and raise their young.§许多海鸟每年都会回到同一个岛上**交配**并养育后代。§补例句
21730§attack§əˈtæk§Passive smoking causes between 30,000 and 60,000 deaths from heart attacks each year in the United States.§在美国，被动吸烟每年导致三到六万人死于心脏病**发作**。§改译文：原译文没译出 attack，加「发作」
21731§discredit§dɪsˈkredɪt§The ugly gossip would discredit us all.§恶毒的流言蜚语会使我们所有人**丧失信誉**。§
21732§flora§ˈflɔːrə§The theme of the meeting is the protection of native flora and fauna.§本次会议以保护当地动**植物**为主题。§
21733§mass§mæs§Mass use of motor vehicles has killed or injured millions of people.§机动车的**大量**使用已造成数百万人伤亡。§
21734§anticipate§ænˈtɪsɪpeɪt§We need someone who can anticipate and respond to changes in the fashion industry.§我们需要一个能**预见**时装业变化并能应对这些变化的人。§
21735§operate§ˈɒpəreɪt§The lift didn't operate.§电梯不**运转**了。§改译文：原译「电梯坏了」括不出 operate（运转），改成「电梯不运转了」
21736§bypass§ˈbaɪpɑːs§If we take the bypass, we'll avoid the town centre.§我们走**旁道**的话，就能绕开镇中心。§改译文：bypass 是绕过市镇的旁道，原译「小路」不对，改「旁道」
21737§undetected§ˌʌndɪˈtektɪd§The family had managed to live undetected for six years outside the border town of Breda, Holland.§这一家人成功地在荷兰布雷达这个边镇外度过了六年**不为人知**的生活。§
21738§shaft§ʃɑːft§A small iron was attached to the bamboo shaft as a weapon.§小铁块被固定在竹**竿**上作为一件武器。§
21739§channel§ˈtʃænl§We're doing some market research for a new television channel starting in two years' time.§我们正在为日后两年内开通一个新的电视**频道**做市场调查。§
21740§determine§dɪˈtɜːmɪn§Before enrollment, students must take a test to determine the level of class they enter.§入学前，学生必须参加入学考试来**确定**他们进入何种等级的班级。§
21741§dominate§ˈdɒmɪneɪt§Cities cease to be port cities when other functions dominate.§当城市的其他功能**占统治地位**时，它就不再是港口城市了。§
21742§instrumental§ˌɪnstrəˈmentl§Doctors have been instrumental in improving living standards in Western society.§在西方社会，医生在提高人们生活质量方面一直发挥着**重要作用**。§
21743§load§ləʊd§Our camera could be loaded in daylight.§我们的相机可以在日光下**装**胶卷。§

21744§improve§ɪmˈpruːv§In an English course with Atlas English Language College, you improve your language skills and make friends from all over the world!§在阿特拉斯英语学院的英语课堂，你可以**提高**自己的英语水平，同时结识来自世界各地的朋友！§
21745§sensitive§ˈsensətɪv§The “environmentally sensitive” landscape was threatened by some buildings.§这处“**易受环境影响**的”风景受到了一些建筑物的威胁。§
21746§abolish§əˈbɒlɪʃ§The ancient Olympics were abolished by the Roman Emperor Theodosius in 393 AD, after Greece lost its independence.§在希腊丧失主权之后，罗马皇帝狄奥多西于公元393年**废除**了古代奥林匹克运动会。§
21747§conception§kənˈsepʃn§This book is designed to help Ph.D. students by explaining different conceptions of the research process.§本书旨在通过解释研究过程中出现的不同**概念**来帮助博士生进行学习。§
21748§encounter§ɪnˈkaʊntə(r)§I encountered a lot of difficulty when I tried to take a rest.§当我打算休息一下时**遇到**了很多麻烦。§
21749§bubble§ˈbʌbl§The water in the pan was beginning to bubble.§锅里的水开始**冒泡**。§
21750§sample§ˈsɑːmpl§The main thing is to make sure we have the right size sample, not too big or too small.§最主要是确保我们有合适的**样本**量，不能太大也不能太小。§
21751§qualitative§ˈkwɒlɪtətɪv§There is little qualitative improvement in their work.§他们的工作没有什么**实质性**的改进。§
21752§accountant§əˈkaʊntənt§The accountant checked the company's financial records carefully before the annual report was published.§在年度报告公布之前，**会计师**仔细核查了公司的财务记录。§补例句
21753§storey§ˈstɔːri§To the west of where I'm standing, we can see the construction of a seventeen-storey building.§从我站的地方往西，可以看到一座17**层**的建筑。§
21754§gang§gæŋ§A gang of young men attacked the police station with machine guns.§**一群**手持机关枪的年轻人袭击了警察局。§
